import subprocess
for p in range(1, 11):
    r = subprocess.run(['pdftotext', '-layout', '-f', str(p), '-l', str(p), 'main.pdf', '-'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    txt = r.stdout
    # find structural markers
    markers = []
    for kw in ['Abstract', 'Introduction', 'Related Work', 'Method', 'Experiments', 'Results', 'Discussion', 'Conclusion', 'Limitations', 'References', 'Appendix', 'Hacking Mode', 'Per-Seed', 'Cross-Logic']:
        if kw in txt:
            markers.append(kw)
    print(f'P{p}: {markers}')
"
